description: Source code for a Python class 'RobotParser' that parses Robot Framework test files to extract test cases, variables, and metadata.

classes.name: RobotParser
classes.description: A parser class for Robot Framework test files, extracting test cases, variables, and metadata.

methods.name: _normalize_var_name
methods.description: Normalizes variable names to Robot-style scalar form.

methods.name: _extract_file_level_variables
methods.description: Extracts variables from the Variables section of a Robot Framework file.

methods.name: _is_assignment_token
methods.description: Checks if a token looks like a variable assignment (e.g., '${x}=').

methods.name: _extract_variables_from_text
methods.description: Extracts variable references from text using regex.

methods.name: _collect_tokens_text
methods.description: Collects non-empty textual values from tokens of a node.

methods.name: _extract_testcase_level_variables
methods.description: Extracts variables used or assigned within a testcase body.

methods.name: parse_file
methods.description: Parses a Robot Framework test file to extract test cases, file-level variables, and testcase-level variables.

methods.name: validate_robot_file
methods.description: Validates if a file is a valid Robot Framework test file.
